description: Models behind the designer results of LLM4band++: the hosted model and its request settings, the open models and their generation settings, and for every result file what was stored and when the calls were made. Every number here was read from the code, the result files or the experiment registry of the working repository; where a value was not recorded the entry says so.
dates_note: All times are UTC. file_mtime_utc is the modification time of the result file in the working repository: the hosted runs wrote their record file call by call, so it is the time of the last call; the open runs were copied from the GPU servers after generation, so it bounds the generation from above. registry_utc gives, per experiment, the registration time, the first data event and the last event of the experiment registry; the registry stores local time of the machine that ran it (US Eastern, UTC-4 in October 2026, checked against the UTC send times stored by realtel-repeat-v1), converted here. Hosted calls happen after registration and before the file time; record_send_time_utc and record_created_utc are timestamps stored in the records themselves (realtel-repeat-v1 only).

hosted.request_code: scripts/coldstart/coldstart_rule_v1.py, function ask(); every designer script passes max_tokens 48000. One user message, no system prompt, no other parameters; up to four attempts on a network error.
hosted.reasoning_mode: Not set by any request parameter. Every stored record reports usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens > 0 (counts per file below), so the hosted model answered in reasoning mode throughout.
hosted.temperature_note: temperature 0 was requested; the records do not show whether the reasoning mode applies it. Repeated calls with the same prompt differ (realtel-repeat-v1: 92% of feature cells agree across three calls), so hosted answers are not reproducible call for call.
hosted.returned_model: deepseek-flash in every record of realtel-repeat-v1, the only run that stored the returned model id
hosted.version_note: The provider serves deepseek-flash as an alias; the experiment registry recorded it as V4.1-Flash on 2026-09-28. The weights behind the alias may change after the runs.
hosted.answer_used: choices[0].message.content, the final answer; the reasoning text was neither used nor stored
hosted.what_is_stored: Per call: the parsed mapping (null when the answer did not parse), ok, the last 300 or 400 characters of the answer (field tail), and the usage block (prompt, completion and reasoning tokens, cache hits); some runs add the wall-clock time, the prompt hash or the finish reason (see each file). Full hosted answers were not stored, except the derivation function of the closure test, whose full answer is in realtel_closure_v1/design_r1.raw.json and whose code is design_r1.py and design_frozen.py.

price_used_for_cost.source: the provider's price page as read for deepseek-flash at peak price (scripts/coldstart/realtel_scale_v1.py PRICE_IN, PRICE_OUT)

open.seed_note: vllm_generate_v2.py passes the seed both to the engine and to SamplingParams; files without a _sd suffix used the default seed 20261002. Even with the same seed, outputs can differ across GPU types, batch composition and vLLM versions.
open.what_is_stored: Full answers: every generated token (the reasoning before </think> and the answer after it) is in the text field, with the number of generated tokens and, for vllm_generate_v2.py, the finish reason (length means the token limit was hit).
